description: Context-dimension overlay for the immutable V1 registry. It adds no aliases, units, hierarchy edges, or model-of relations.

context_dimension_annotations.provenance: Scientific-type audit of the existing local registry entry; no external canonical identity is asserted.
context_dimension_annotations.scientific_rationale: Non-small-cell lung cancer names a disease/model context and EGFR-mutant names a genotype context; neither alone is a cell identity.
context_dimension_annotations.generic_applicability: All target or observed uses of this registry concept.
